changelog: **Skill vocabulary is an internship module (#3150):** `/admin/skills` and every `/api/admin/skills/*` handler are now gated on the `mentorship` capability — its only consumers are mentor suggestion and candidate ↔ requisition matching. A MARKETING tenant no longer sees the sidebar entry, the URL answers 404 and the APIs refuse; INTERNSHIP is unchanged.

en: The sales CRM no longer shows the Skills screen — it only fed mentor and candidate matching.
tr: Satış CRM'inde Beceriler ekranı artık görünmüyor — yalnızca mentor ve aday eşleştirmesini besliyordu.
de: Im Vertriebs-CRM erscheint der Bildschirm „Fähigkeiten“ nicht mehr — er diente nur dem Mentoren- und Kandidaten-Matching.
